title: John
author: Traditionally attributed to John the apostle.
audience: Believers and seekers, so that they may believe Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God.
historicalSetting: John presents Jesus as the eternal Word made flesh, the Son of God, who gives life through His death and resurrection.
themes: Jesus as the Son of God
keyVerse: John 20:31 — "These are written, that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God."
christFocus: John is explicitly Christ-centered, showing Jesus as the eternal Word, Lamb of God, I AM, crucified Savior, risen Lord, and giver of life.
